title: Founded Pinduoduo in 2015 as a Shanghai-based social e-commerce
statement: Founded Pinduoduo in 2015 as a Shanghai-based social e-commerce platform.
outcome: Pinduoduo became the largest agriculture platform in China and, per Wikipedia, one of the country's dominant e-commerce companies; Huang's exact current relationship to the company (which later restructured under PDD Holdings) was not confirmed by a primary source in this pass.

title: Stepped down as CEO in July 2020
statement: Stepped down as CEO in July 2020, transitioning to chairman and handing operational control to Chen Lei.
